verdict.rationale: Founder Law offers a fully managed EB-1A, EB-1B and EB-2 NIW package from strategy to approval alongside its O-1A work-visa package. It explicitly mentions mapping a multi-year path to an EB-1A, notes that EB-1A applicants can self-petition, and includes an immigration roadmap in its strategy session. Its Techstars library also covers the green card process and the path to citizenship. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of how O-1 holders sequence into EB-1A/NIW (timing, evidence reuse, dual intent), and independent or client corroboration of the continuation strategy.
